scope: GB-T0.02.02.T1 (#16). Exceptions cover only review-required licenses, pinned by exact name, version and license string. They never cover prohibited, missing or unknown licenses. Entries are agent-proposed from lockfile metadata and are pending owner review; they are not legal clearance.

exceptions.name: dompurify
exceptions.reason: Dual-licensed. The checker's conservative OR rule does not select a branch, so the expression is review-required. Apache-2.0 is allowlisted and is the branch this entry relies on; the owner must record that election and retain Apache-2.0 notices. If MPL-2.0 were relied on instead, its file-level copyleft terms would apply to modified MPL files. Reached from research-fixtures/canvas (no dev flag in the lockfile). Proposed; owner review pending.

exceptions.name: pako
exceptions.reason: Conjunctive expression: MIT is allowlisted, but Zlib is review-listed and not on the allowlist, so both terms apply. Zlib is a permissive license; it is not added to the allowlist. Reached from research-fixtures/canvas (no dev flag in the lockfile). Proposed; owner review of Zlib notice obligations pending.

exceptions.name: robust-predicates
exceptions.reason: Unlicense is a public-domain dedication with no attribution obligation, but it is review-listed rather than allowlisted, so the owner must accept it explicitly. Reached from research-fixtures/canvas (no dev flag in the lockfile). Proposed; owner review pending.
